description: Returns a link that carries everything collected so far into the WebinarIgnition dashboard, so the host can finish there. Take it at the end of a conversation, for example "Send me that, I want to keep working in my account." It needs the session id, or the finished text when the session alone does not hold it. You can add the host's address and a rating from 1 to 10. It only makes a link: nothing is written to a site and nothing is sent to anyone. Words hosts use: handover link, dashboard, keep working, my account

content.description: finished text to carry over, if the session alone does not hold it.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

url.description: The WordPress address (seite). With this call: the host's WordPress address to point the handover link at.

name: wi_create_handoff_link
title: Create a handover link
